hints.title: Token Extraction
hints.text: Tokenize the sentence by splitting on whitespace characters.

hints.title: Digit Exclusion
hints.text: Check whether any token contains digit characters and discard it if so.

hints.title: Punctuation and Hyphen Rules
hints.text: Ensure hyphens appear at most once surrounded by letters, and punctuation only appears at the end.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) linear scan over sentence characters
complexity.notes: Validates tokens for hyphen placement, punctuation position, and absence of digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Complex single regular expressions can be brittle across hyphen edge cases.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit character validation provides robust linear verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should carefully check hyphen boundaries and punctuation position.
